name: admin
description: The owner's verbs on yaks.app — accounts, sign-in links, the fee, deploys, logs, rollback and revert — as `yak admin` tools. Unpublished: installed into the box's own yak.

name: alias
description: Assigns persistent, unique names to graph entities and resolves those names wherever an entity id is accepted.

name: api
description: Serves graph writes, queries, and live query subscriptions through an HTTP and WebSocket request handler.

name: archetype
description: Identifies component-table sets by content hash, caches presence matches and transitions, and maintains each graph entity's archetype.

name: blob
description: Stores text property values by their SHA-256 in a database table, directory, or object store, while reads and writes still deal in text.

name: builders
description: An instruction plus its inputs builds one output, keyed by a hash of what produced it and reused while that key holds.

name: canvas
description: Represents canvases, cards, viewports, and split layouts as graph components and supplies geometry functions for rendering them.

name: cli
description: The yak command line: it opens the graph a config file names, or connects to an MCP server, and turns every tool it finds there into a subcommand parsed through that tool's own input schema.

name: client
description: Assembles a browser graph: server synchronization, reactive queries, and IndexedDB storage for the components this browser owns.

name: code
description: Reads a codebase into a graph: packages, modules, exported symbols and imports, with their doc comments as searchable text, synced incrementally by Git blob.

name: connections
description: Integrations and connections: the outside services a space can reach, the link between a space or a person and one, and the credential behind it, kept as a secret.

name: context
description: Constructs instruction snapshots and prompt entries for graph transcripts, leaving admission, storage, and execution to the caller.

name: d1
description: Adapts Cloudflare D1 to graph storage with asynchronous queries and writes submitted as atomic statement batches.

name: design
description: A proposal, the review it gets, and the architecture that stands once it is decided.

name: doc
description: Defines a shared graph component for an entity's title and Markdown body.

name: dreaming
description: Standing intentions filed under a project, which @yaks/builders builds on a schedule, a record of how often each memory has been recalled, and the `.order=hot` ranking that record decays along.

name: durable-object
description: Provides graph storage on a Cloudflare Durable Object's embedded SQLite and connects hibernatable WebSockets to query subscriptions.

name: edge
description: Represents typed links as graph entities with content-derived ids and supports traversal through storage reads and SQL queries.

name: effects
description: Runs isolated handlers for component creation, changes, and removal after a graph transaction has committed, with an optional durable ledger.

name: egress
description: Calls going out with a credential the caller never holds: each sentinel swapped for its connection's key or token, for a caller allowed to use it and a host its integration names, with a refused access token refreshed once.

name: embedding
description: Maintains text embeddings for graph entities and adds nearest-neighbor ranking to queries through an injected embedder.

name: esbuild
description: Compiles an app's TypeScript and npm imports: the module graph of its files, what a deploy must compile, and the compile itself with @cloudflare/worker-bundler inside workerd.

name: fts
description: Indexes a graph's text properties with SQLite FTS5 and adds ranked full-text search to queries.

name: git
description: Builds Git trees and commits from a file manifest, stores the objects as graph entities, and serves clones over Git's read-only smart HTTP protocol.

name: goal
description: A standing purpose that work satisfies, and the link recording which work satisfied it.

name: graph
description: The entity-component data model, the bundle write format, and the phased, pluggable transaction pipeline the yaks packages share.

name: harness
description: Runs an agent on this machine over a yak graph: the machine the session runner is lent, the machine and graph tools, and the terminal app.

name: heal
description: Files one task per unexpected failure, keyed by its fault, and starts an agent session to fix it.

name: hook
description: An event another system delivered, kept as it arrived: the payload, the route it came in on, and whether it was signed.

name: html
description: Serializes registry-selected views to server-side HTML through Preact without a DOM.

name: id
description: Generates entity UUIDs, formats and parses human-readable ids from vocabulary-declared prefixes, and contributes the entity number those ids are built from.

name: journal
description: Records every committed graph transaction, and who wrote it, inside that same transaction: entity history, undo, and a cursor-based feed of changes.

name: kernel
description: The components most graphs of work need: the entity row itself, the marks recording who touched a thing and when, and the tags that give an edge its meaning.

name: key
description: Represents an entity's identifying values as separate graph entities, with ids derived from each value and its kind to enforce uniqueness.

name: mail
description: Represents letters and their delivery outcomes as graph components, sends them through a sender the caller supplies, and converts arrivals to bundles.

name: markdown
description: Parses GitHub Flavored Markdown into structural renderer nodes rather than HTML strings or terminal escape sequences.

name: match
description: Runs query ASTs against entity bundles held in memory, without SQL or a database.

name: mcp
description: Exposes a graph through generic MCP tools for writes, queries, entity inspection, schema inspection, and optional search.

name: mcp-client
description: Consume remote MCP tools as portable graph Tool definitions over Streamable HTTP.

name: member
description: Access control for a graph: space membership, per-app permission grants, and access modes, with the checks that enforce them on reads and writes.

name: memory
description: Stores a person's words with context as graph entities and retrieves them for subsequent conversations.

name: mirror
description: Syncs files and a graph through bindings, each direction optional, reporting a path changed on both sides as a conflict instead of overwriting it.

name: model
description: Defines provider-neutral model requests and replies, plus graph components for providers, models, and tools, without implementing a transport.

name: names
description: Resolves entity names from the properties a component vocabulary marks for name lookup.

name: notify
description: How somebody is notified: a knock aimed at an entity, what they watch or mute, and an open conversation.

name: oauth
description: The OAuth authorization-code client for a provider described as data, and its building blocks: a serialized store of private authorization records, PKCE verifiers and challenges, and correlated attempts with deadlines.

name: openai
description: Implements the model interface over OpenAI's streaming Responses API using fetch, with API-key or Codex sign-in authentication.

name: openrouter
description: Implements the model interface over OpenRouter's streaming Responses API, reusing the portable transport from @yaks/openai without its credentials or native tools.

name: page
description: Records a web page as it was seen: its canonical address becomes its entity id, and its bytes are stored as one self-contained document.

name: persona
description: Who is acting and what they are responsible for — the people a graph knows, the personas an agent runs with, the roles those personas are assigned to, and a persona rendered as one markdown document.

name: platform
description: What a hosting platform keeps about the apps it serves — spaces, apps, deploys, hostnames, plans and meters.

name: preact
description: Renders registry-selected views with Preact and binds them to an entity store with subscriptions scoped to mounted components.

name: process
description: Starts, adopts and supervises operating-system processes, recording each one as a graph entity with its pid, output and exit code.

name: project
description: A portfolio: the projects work is filed under, the boards that are saved filters over it, the ventures being built, and where a project lands its source.

name: query
description: Parses query strings into a serializable AST and provides builders for the same AST without interpreting a component schema.

name: ram
description: Implements synchronous graph storage over a Map of entity bundles, using the in-memory query evaluator instead of a database.

name: render
description: Selects views, editors, and actions for entity bundles through a query-matched registry independent of the rendering host.

name: secrets
description: Secrets that flow through the graph and are kept somewhere else: a write's value is sealed into a vault and the graph keeps a random handle in its place.

name: session
description: Represents sessions as graph transcripts, derives status from their entries, manages claims, and runs a transcript wherever its effects are worked.

name: spawn
description: Runs an agent CLI as a detached child process and reads its JSON-lines stdout back into the graph as a session transcript.

name: sql
description: Compiles a query AST and a component schema into a SQL statement and its bound parameters, through a backend-independent relational representation.

name: sqlite
description: Builds a SQLite schema from a component vocabulary, reads query results as entity bundles, and applies transactional patches.

name: sync
description: Synchronizes a client graph with a server, applies live query updates, and reconciles optimistic writes or reverts them when refused.

name: task
description: Task components for a graph: a status computed from marks instead of stored, dependency counts, and completion attribution.

name: text
description: Serializes portable renderer trees as Markdown or plain text without a DOM, removing control bytes from text and link destinations.

name: tmux
description: A tmux pane as an entity: what is running in the terminal somebody is watching, and the target string tmux accepts.

name: tools
description: Executes recorded graph tool invocations and stores results independently of sessions.

name: tui
description: Renders Preact trees in a terminal through a replaceable backend, with a diffing ANSI painter and scrolling, input, and layout widgets.

name: tunnel
description: Reaches a machine from a hosted space through a Cloudflare Tunnel and a Workers VPC Service: the account calls that make one, the connector that runs it on the machine, and the filter that keeps the tunnel to the paths the machine opened.

name: vocab
description: Loads and validates component vocabularies expressed as JSON Schema with custom keywords, exposing property types, path routing, and display ordering.

name: wake
description: Stores one-shot and recurring schedules as graph components, marking due wakes as fired and advancing their next scheduled times.

name: web
description: The web door: canvas, cards, boards and editing in a browser, served by yak serve over @yaks/api and @yaks/client.

name: workerd
description: Serves the graph API from Cloudflare Workers with WebSocket upgrades, request authentication, and forwarding to Durable Objects.

name: workers-ai
description: Implements the model interface over Cloudflare Workers AI, through the AI binding a Worker is given: chat messages out, either answer shape back, no key.

name: yaml
description: Parses YAML and JSON declarations and extracts Markdown frontmatter as graph bundles.
